title: Recovering Ground Truth from Many Biased Weak Judges

original_idea.body:
# Recovering Ground Truth from Many Biased Weak Judges

**Problem:** Whether diverse-prompted LLM judges err independently enough for aggregation to recover truth is open.

**Direction:** Run several weak judges with varied personas/prompts on the same QuALITY items. Apply majority vote, confidence-weighted, and Dawid-Skene aggregation; compare to the best single judge. Measure how much error decorrelation aggregation buys.

**Why it matters:** Tests whether prompt-diversified ensembling is a cheap mitigation for systematic oversight error.

**Relevant context:** Anthropic agenda; Dawid-Skene; Kenton et al. (2024).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: prompt-diversified ensembling as a cheap mitigation for systematic oversight error is defensible.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Multiple judge prompts + aggregation (majority/Dawid-Skene) is guided; the latent-truth estimator needs care.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused aggregation-vs-best-single comparison; several aggregation methods add breadth.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Deployable oversight de-biasing on public models, external-friendly.

novelty.reasoning: Ensembling/Dawid-Skene known; the prompt-diversity decorrelation question for oversight may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Aggregation methods known; oversight decorrelation angle plausibly open.
